summary: All six phases delivered every planned artifact. The `steme audit` chain — rulepack parsing, Oxc import graph, scope evaluation, diagnostic rendering, and the seeded-violation E2E harness — is fully implemented and all nine §A.9 acceptance criteria are covered. Three minor deviations exist: (1) `vitest.config.ts` adds `passWithNoTests: true` beyond the 'identical to sandbox' spec (justified to keep the full gate green before tests exist); (2) the audit package script was pre-placed in phase-01 rather than phase-05, leaving phase-05's `package.json` edit as a no-op; (3) the phase-05 handoff document was not produced, creating a documentation gap in the handoff chain. None of these affect the functional outcome.

findings.message: vitest.config.ts adds `passWithNoTests: true` beyond the plan's 'identical shape to sandbox' spec. Justified: without it, `vitest run` exits 1 on an empty test suite, breaking the full gate before phase-02 lands any tests. Documented in handoff.

The `"audit": "node src/cli/main.ts audit"` script was added to package.json in phase-01 rather than phase-05 (where the plan placed it). This caused phase-05 to skip its planned package.json edit. Functionally identical; both phases' reconciliation entries are consistent with this ordering.

Phase-05 handoff document is missing ('phase-handoff.md unavailable for phase-05'). The required handoff content — exact invocation, STEME_RULEPACK override mechanism, resolved skill-path form — was not recorded. Phase-06 succeeded, but the documentation gap breaks the handoff chain.
apps/steme/package.json was not edited in phase-05 (reconciliation: partially-matched). The audit script was pre-placed in phase-01, so there was nothing to write. Justified.

Criteria 7 and 7b in audit-harness.e2e.test.ts duplicate tests already present in main.test.ts. The plan required one test per §A.9 criterion in the harness; the duplication is intentional and documented in the handoff. Not a defect.

attentionPoints: Phase-05 handoff document was not produced. If a future phase needed to reference the STEME_RULEPACK override mechanism or the skill-path form from phase-05's handoff, there would be no authoritative source. The phax runner should enforce handoff document creation before marking a phase complete.

apps/steme/package.json is marked partially-matched in the reconciliation (not touched in phase-05) because the audit script was pre-written in phase-01. If the run tooling uses touched-in-phase metadata for audit trails, this ordering should be noted.

Criteria 7/7b tests are duplicated between audit-harness.e2e.test.ts and main.test.ts. Intentional per the plan (one test per §A.9 criterion required in the harness), but worth revisiting for deduplication as the suite grows.
